Add site covariates to a count history

Source: R/07_count_history.R
pam_add_site_covariates.Rd

Attaches covariates, such as habitat or elevation, to histories that were built without them. Rows are matched to the sites by name, so the order of your table does not matter.

Usage

pam_add_site_covariates(x, covariates, replace = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A pam_count_history or pam_count_histories.

covariates

A data frame with a site_id column and one column per covariate. Every site of x needs a row; extra rows are ignored. Without a site_id column the table needs one row per site, in the order of the sites.

replace

If FALSE (the default), a covariate that is already present is an error; if TRUE, it is replaced.

Value

x with the covariates added.

See also

pam_as_count_history(), pam_model_input()

Examples

counts <- matrix(c(0, 2, 5, 1, 0, 3), nrow = 3,
                 dimnames = list(c("site_a", "site_b", "site_c"), NULL))
hist <- pam_as_count_history(counts, species = "Example species")
#> Error in pam_as_count_history(counts, species = "Example species"): could not find function "pam_as_count_history"
covs <- data.frame(site_id = c("site_c", "site_a", "site_b"), canopy = c(0.9, 0.2, 0.5))
pam_add_site_covariates(hist, covs)$site_covariates
#> Error in pam_add_site_covariates(hist, covs): could not find function "pam_add_site_covariates"
